response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_rating) SELECT p.rating, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_mean AS diff_above_mean FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_ratio > o.overall_mean

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is exclusive: 'replacement cost cutoff of 20.99' is read as replacement_cost > 20.99 (qualifying films exceed the cutoff).
Ratings are grouped as stored in film.rating; ratings with no qualifying films do not appear and are not counted in the overall mean.

alternatives.interpretation: Cutoff is inclusive: films with replacement_cost >= 20.99 qualify.
